---
title: "TidyTuesday First Analysis"
toc: false


---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

yarn <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2022/2022-10-11/yarn.csv')

```


```{r}
ggplot(yarn, aes(x = wpi)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  labs(
    x = "Wraps per Inch",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Wraps per Inch of a Type of Yarn"
  )

```



```{r}
ggplot(yarn, aes(x = discontinued, fill = machine_washable)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(
    title = "Are discontinued yarns less likely to be machine washable?",
    x = "Discontinued?",
    y = "Proportion machine washable",
    fill = "Machine Washable?"
  )
```
